From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood + LedgerCore discovery — next steps

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the clear overview of LedgerCore's latency and data residency constraints. Quick recap of what we heard:
- Primary goal: embed low-latency generation for transaction enrichment in production (p95 < 120ms).
- Data residency: pilot must live in us-east (customer-managed VPC preferred).
- Success metrics: latency, per-token cost, and accuracy on internal prompt set (we'll ship an eval).

Next steps we recommend:
1) 45-minute technical deep dive (platform/infra + security) — demo of a representative workflow + architecture Q&A.
2) Procurement touchpoint to align SOW and commercial checkpoints.

Proposed slots next week (all PT):
- Tue 2025-04-15, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2025-04-16, 14:00–14:45
Please confirm which works and who from your side should join (infra, security, procurement).

I've attached the call notes and a short checklist listing the security artifacts we'll bring to the meeting. If you want, we can also prepare a short cost estimate for the pilot ahead of the procurement call.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (notes), redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (artifact list)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Marissa
